rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person’s everyday social embarrassment or an awkward situation.

example.english: Saying the wrong thing in front of so many people was a real embarrassment.
example.traditional: 我喺咁多人面前講錯嘢，真係好尷尬。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 gong2 co3 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaam3 gaai3

rows.note: Choose this for serious humiliation or a person or thing regarded as a disgrace, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: This scandal was a major embarrassment for the company.
example.traditional: 呢宗醜聞對間公司嚟講係一大恥辱。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 cau2 man4 deoi3 gaan1 gung1 si1 lei4 gong2 hai6 jat1 daai6 ci2 juk6

rows.note: Use this colloquial word for a person who brings shame on the family, as in “You are an embarrassment to this family.”

example.english: You getting that drunk in front of our relatives is a real embarrassment to our family.
example.traditional: 你喺親戚面前醉到咁，真係我哋屋企嘅羞家。
example.jyutping: nei5 hai2 can1 cik1 min6 cin4 zeoi3 dou3 gam3 zan1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ge3 sau1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for a person or thing that becomes an object of public ridicule and thereby causes embarrassment.

example.english: That promotional video was so outrageous that it became a public embarrassment.
example.traditional: 嗰套宣傳片太離譜，成為全城笑柄。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 syun1 cyun4 pin2 taai3 lei4 pou2 sing4 wai4 cyun4 sing4 siu3 beng3
